source: DENSO press release: DENSO Launches Battery Passport Service Supporting (08-25-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: DENSO launched DENSO Digital Product Passport Solution for Battery, a battery passport service (based on the Battery Pass-Ready consortium data model, with access control and blockchain-based tamper resistance) to help automakers, battery makers and others comply with the European Battery Regulation, under which battery passports become mandatory from February 2027; DENSO plans to extend it to other digital product passports under the ESPR.
